newsitem.title: USA: Ergo diabetes drug effective in Phase III.
newsitem.headline: Ergo diabetes drug effective in Phase III.

text.p: Ergo Science Corp said Thrusday that a Phase III clinical trial showed that Ergoset tablets effectively reduce blood sugar levels while dramatically lowering certain blood lipids in obese patients with Type II diabetes.

"Generally after meals, people with Type II diabetes have increased concentrations of atherogenic lipoproteins in their blood. As such, it is important to reduce these potentially damaging lipids," said Anthony Cincotta, chief scientific officer in a press release.
According to Ergo, timed Ergoset administration works by resetting the body's internal "clock" that regulates daily metabolic activities.
The company noted that 16 million Americans suffer from Type II diabetes, which is a major risk factor in cardiovascular disease.
Ergo said that its findings will be presented June 22 at the 57th Annual Scientific Sessions of the American Diabetes Association in Boston.
